# launchdarkly_observability_filter_rules (Data Source)

Provides a LaunchDarkly observability filter rules data source.

~> **Beta:** This data source uses a beta API. Beta data sources may change or be removed in future versions.

This data source allows you to list the observability ingestion filter rules of a LaunchDarkly project, optionally for one product.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "launchdarkly_observability_filter_rules" "logs" {
  project_key  = "example-project"
  product_type = "logs"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_key` (String) The project key.

### Optional

- `product_type` (String) Only list rules for this product. Must be one of `sessions`, `errors`, `logs`, `traces`, or `metrics`. Omit to list the rules of every product.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The data source ID: the project key, or `project_key/product_type` when `product_type` is set.
- `rules` (Attributes List) The filter rules, in the order LaunchDarkly returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `attributes` (List of String) Attribute keys the rule filters instead of the whole item.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled.
- `key` (String) The rule key.
- `name` (String) The rule name.
- `operation` (String) `include` or `exclude`.
- `product_type` (String) The product the rule filters.
- `query` (String) The search query that selects the data the rule applies to.
- `rate` (Number) The fraction of matching data the operation applies to.
- `version` (Number) The rule's version.
